title: García de Toledo to Philip II, 16 July 1565 (Great Siege of Malta), AGS Estado leg. 1394 nos. 247 and 249

steps.what: Worked out the PARES image route (cookie jar, dbCode, zoom 10) and fetched six images.
Transcribed the figure runs digit for digit with the clear text around them.
Runs beside clear words read as 'seiscientos' and 'en tiera', fixing a c d e i l n o r s t.
Key order is alphabetical, so the remaining letters (f, x, y, z) were predicted from their neighbours and confirmed in words.
Decoded the whole letter; nonsense in the output located misread digits, which were corrected on the images.
All groups in 12-43, all 32 used, no odd runs; names such as Provana di Leinì fit the Sicilian record for July 1565.

Found the same-day companion letter EST,LEG,1394,249 (duplicate, one page) by PARES search; its cipher runs decode with the same key (entrado el socorro, Cabo Bono, Argel, las galeras con la gente a la Goleta, partiran las galeras manana), adding a barred-theta sign for ll. Not read in full.

Novelty re-examined. G. Lasry (21 Sept 2026): on cryptiana 'undeciphered' means no interlinear or nearby deciphered copy, not unsolved; unsolved material is on the unsolved page. The key was rebuilt here from two cribs in the clear text, but it is easy and may have been recovered before; the claim is a reading of this letter, not a first break.
Fetched the four PARES images of no. 249 (record 3576586) with the cookie-jar route, zoom 10; image 1 is the letter, 2 and 3 blank, 4 the address leaf.
Transcribed the 13 lines carrying figures (25 runs, 150 tokens) and the clear text around them into transcription_249.txt, line by line, appending as each crop was read.
Decoded with the no. 247 key unchanged; decode.py extended to take the two extra signs (theta = ll, M-like sign = r) without changing its no. 247 output (diffed against the committed version).
Tested the overlined M-like sign before 18 36 33 38 19 36 37 12 as 're' (giving 'reespuesta') against 'r' (giving 'respuesta'); 're' rejected.

Every run divides into Spanish words (entrado el socorro, la llegada de los, Cabo Bono, Argel, las galeras, gente a la Goleta, a mal tienpo, respuesta del Maestre, forma de ponelle mas gente por, falta, pide mas de la, agora le puedo, partiran, manana): 150/150 tokens; es-golden-age -1.67 per char word-divided, shuffled -5.89. Content matches no. 247 (Algiers squadron off Cape Bon).
Re-examined the one doubtful group '17.0' at 5x: a reduced 3 or blot between 7 and 0; only 17 30 keeps the run even and gives 'entrado'. Not settled from the image.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 2066 tokens, 34 types, es-golden-age order 4: reading -2.136 per letter; random keys -5.309 (z 8.6); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.462 (mean -3.484, z 82.6); annealer on the real text -2.127. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.136; polyphony 0.0; 0 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.127

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The alphabetical homophonic key (figures 12-43) was rebuilt from cribs in the clear Spanish around the figures in the letter itself; Tomokiyo's 'undeciphered' means no contemporary decipherment, and whether the key existed elsewhere is unknown. No. 249 was then read with the same key unchanged (two extra signs).
outcome.notes: No. 247: open word readings only (yaretas, secanos); every group has a value. No. 249 (2 Oct 2026): 150/150 tokens read with the same key; one doubtful group (17.0 = 17 30) and one single-occurrence M-like sign read as r.

prior.where: Tomokiyo lists 1565 Malta cipher letters as undeciphered and not this one; PARES has no decipherment. 'Undeciphered' on cryptiana means no contemporary decipherment, not unsolved; whether Tomokiyo or anyone else holds this easy alphabetical key is not known.

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
